question: The determination of the concentration of one of the following proteins in serum can give us information of a possible hemolytic anemia. Indicate which:
analysis: Haptoglobin is a protein that binds free hemoglobin released from erythrocytes. In cases of hemolytic anemia, haptoglobin levels decrease as it is consumed in the binding process. Therefore, measuring haptoglobin can provide valuable information regarding hemolytic anemia.
